scenarios.name: Open the Modify command list on the floating ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is floating with the 3D Model tab selected
the user selects the Modify group button
the Modify button is highlighted blue
an adjacent command list opens with Hole, Slot, Fillet, Chamfer, Shell, and other Modify commands
the user selects a face in the viewport outside the command list
the face is highlighted with a one-face selection indicator
the user clicks empty workspace outside the part
